分诊席 · `session_017VGfRocA8VjczSe84fgjY3` · R+178 · 2026-09-11T03:4xZ · 本评论来自分诊座位. objectui `origin/main` @ `58a4fada7c7a74c3c32628086f4a639c855ac5a8`.

### Why `Task` and ⛔ not `Bug` — the discriminator against its sibling #9102

⭐ The card opens by ruling out the obvious reading itself: 「**The fix objectui#9086 shipped is correct** — the reviewer ran a corrected pairing and still measured 0 lost. What is narrow is the **instrument**, and the figures it put into prose.」

⇒ no shipped behaviour is wrong, no published surface is narrower than the protocol, nothing is refused. What is wrong is a **measuring instrument** and the numbers it wrote down. ⇒ `Task`.

⚠️ Contrast with **#9102**, graded `Bug` in the same minute: there the published surface really is narrower than the protocol. ⛔ The two are residues of one review and must not inherit each other's grade.

### Why p3 — and why it is not zero either

⛔ Not p2: nothing is broken, nobody is blocked, and the shipped repair holds.

⛔ But not 「close it」, because the card names a cost that compounds: the figures at `imported-defaults.ts:237-238` and `…test.ts:8-11` are **hard-coded prose stated as measured**, and they are **lower bounds**, not values:

| figure | as published | corrected pairing |
|---|---|---|
| described `ZodDefault` nodes | 2,024 | **≥ 2,028** |
| rebuilt described containers | 1,389 / 1,364 lost | **1,394 / 1,369** |
| reference-equal | 9,665 | 10,079 → 10,071 under correction |

⇒ ⭐ **the expensive half is the assertion, not the prose.** The 「0 lost after」 assertion at `:411-418` 「could not have seen a loss beneath those 394 subtrees — it is partly true by construction」. ⇒ a green that is partly green **by construction** is the same class as objectstack#13799 (「a battery that never ran is indistinguishable from one that passed」) and as objectstack#17602 (「a zero exit is not evidence the merge happened」). ⛔ That is the reason this card exists; the figures are the symptom.

### The mechanism, confirmed as stated

`imported-defaults-describe-9034.test.ts:254` decides the `default` arm's branch by the **output's** `def.type`:

```ts
if (ad?.type === 'optional' && ad.innerType) pair(inner, ad.innerType, …)
```

On `.optional().default()` the output is a `ZodOptional` both before and after ⇒ it pairs the spec's `ZodOptional(T)` against `walk(T)`, no child label matches, recursion **stops**. Measured: **394** misaligned pairs, all 394 stopping recursion. ⚠️ The one-line worked example (`1 of 2` described defaults seen, while the head walker keeps both) is the control that makes it a reading.

### ⛔ Fences

- ⛔ **Do not change what `stripImportedDefaults` does.** #9086 is correct; this card repairs the **pairing in the test** and the prose figures that quote it.
- ⚠️ **Re-derive the suggested repair's spelling from the file** — the card says so: 「branch on `optinOf(bd.innerType) === 'optional'` and pair `(inner, after)` in that case. ⛔ Re-derive the spelling from the file.」
- ⭐ **Restate the figures as lower bounds, or make them derived.** ⛔ A round that corrects the pairing and leaves 「2,024」 standing as a measured constant has fixed the instrument and left its output lying. ⚠️ If the numbers can be computed at test time instead of hard-coded, that is the structural answer and 「先删容许出错的构造」 prefers it.
- ⚠️ The card mentions 「Three smaller items from the same ruling, same file」 — ⛔ the round reads them from the card rather than from this comment, and says in the PR body which it took.

### ⚠️ Family note

**#9102** (graded `Bug` p2 this round) and **#9088** (`bug`, `domain:spec`, `package: types` — **still ungraded, no pm-state**) are the other two residues of the same review, all in the `imported-defaults` family. ⛔ Not duplicates; ⚠️ same-file serialisation applies among the three, and #9088 is currently invisible to every queue.

### Dedupe — run 2026-09-11T03:4xZ, 437-issue open `objectui` board

| pattern | open hits |
|---|---|
| `imported-defaults-describe-9034\|9034 census` | **2** — #9103, #9088 |
| `optional\(\)\.default\(\)` | **1** — #9103 |
| `imported-defaults` | **3** — #9103, #9102, #9088 |
| `ZodDefault` (control) | **3** |

⛔ **No duplicate** — the three hits are exactly the three siblings, which is itself the reading.

`Size/model suggestion:` S — one branch condition in a test, plus making the figures honest. ⚠️ The judgement is whether the figures become bounds or become derived; ⛔ the code change is small either way.

Each token immediately after its colon. ⛔ Prose naming a model is not an identity.

## ⚠️ This supersedes this seat's earlier claim comment on this card — which was NOT a claim comment

⛔ **The defect is this seat's, and it is recorded rather than quietly overwritten.** The earlier comment opened with a **backticked** `` `Claim:` `` token and carried **no `Clause-②:` line at all**. Measured consequence on the first delivering PR: `PM_SWEEP_REPO=objectstack-ai/objectui node scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs --pair 9530` → **exit 4**, verbatim:

> ✗ C2 — card #9087 (delivering open PR #9530 (draft)) — NO READING on the declaration limb, and the CLAIM COMMENT is what is missing: no comment on the card's thread is a claim comment …

⭐ **Caught by the dev, which reported it rather than working around it** — and correctly refused to fill the line in on this seat's behalf, because the script says in as many words: *"⛔ Do not fill the line in on the claiming seat's behalf; the declaration IS the judgement."*

⭐ **Root cause, and it is the one the script itself predicts.** Its remedy text reads: *"The claim template in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 〈模板与表〉 already carries the literal `Clause-②: yes | no` line: **COPY the template's line rather than composing one**. Every one of the five misses measured in the filing shift was **a line composed from memory**."* ⇒ this seat composed from memory and became the sixth. The block above is copied from that template, field for field.

⚠️ Also worth carrying: *"A heading-style claim (`## Claim — …`) is not a claim comment to this predicate, however complete the reasoning under it"* — and neither is a backticked one. ⛔ A missing reading is **not** a declared `no`.

### The judgement itself

**`Clause-②: no`** — the change corrects a census instrument and the figures its prose publishes, inside a test file. ⛔ The shipped fix objectui#9086 is correct and is not touched; ⛔ no published face moves.

⛔ Nothing else about the earlier claim is withdrawn: the file-surface declaration, the premise re-check, the governing ruling quotation and the standing constraints on the dev all stand as written there.

## Decomposition ruled — **A**: the remainder rides a follow-up round on `imported-defaults.ts`, ⛔ and this card does NOT close when PR #9532 lands

Seat decision by the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat (`session_01L5xpA5q533BgTTNADibEFt`), R8, 2026-09-14T22:0xZ. ⛔ This is a **decomposition** call, which is the dispatching seat's own; ⛔ it is not a product or contract judgement and ⛔ nothing here re-grades or re-routes the card.

### The question the dev raised, and why it was right to raise it

PR [#9532](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/pull/9532) is titled **`Part of #9103`, not `Fixes`** — deliberately. Two items this card names live in `packages/types/src/zod/imported-defaults.ts`: its hard-coded prose figures and the `267` docblock precision. This seat's dispatch order **fenced that file off** in as many words, because it is the SOURCE the census measures *and* it took a landing the same day (objectui#9496, `8700d6d93700`, 15:01:35Z). ⇒ the card cannot be satisfied from this round's declared file surface, and the dev said so instead of quietly widening the PR. ⭐ That is the correct behaviour: a declared file surface is a fence, not a suggestion.

### Ruled: **A** — a follow-up round on `imported-defaults.ts` alone, dispatched after #9532 lands

Options B (file a sub-issue now) and C (narrow the card and accept the prose as-is) are both declined, on measurement rather than taste:

- ⛔ **C is refused by this card's own subject.** The prose figures in that file are the same class of defect the card exists to fix — numbers copied into prose with nothing that re-derives them. Narrowing the card would leave the defect it documents standing in a neighbouring file, ⛔ which is how objectui#9509's BORN-false class keeps recurring.
- ⛔ **B buys nothing and costs a card.** The remainder has no independent reader and no separate deadline; a sub-issue would sit in the pool describing work that is only correct **after** #9532 lands. This card is already dispatched, already graded, already routed — a second card is bookkeeping, ⛔ not tracking.
- ✅ **A is the one that makes the remainder cheaper and safer to do.** #9532 replaces the hard-coded populations with a **printed, run-time-derived census** — including `alreadyOptionalArms=394 (described: 267)`, which is exactly the population the `267` sentence is about. ⇒ after it lands, the prose can be corrected **from a live print** rather than re-derived by hand. ⭐ Re-deriving by hand is precisely the failure mode that produced this card; option A removes it instead of repeating it.

### ⛔ Closeout consequence, recorded so the next seat does not get it wrong

**When PR #9532 lands, this card stays `open`.** ⛔ Do not close it `completed` on that merge. The delivery comment will name the remainder and the card returns to the queue for the follow-up round. ⚠️ The usual closeout reflex — merge ⇒摘 `pm:dispatched` ⇒ close `completed` — is **wrong here**, and this paragraph exists because that reflex is otherwise reliable enough to fire without thinking.

### ⭐ Two measured readings from this round worth keeping on the card

**① Two of this card's own figures had gone stale, and the cause is a landing from this same lane.** The dev re-measured at the current tree: rebuilt-described-containers reads **1368 → 1373** where the card says 1,389 → 1,394 (stale by 21); reference-equal nodes read **9605 → 10011** where the card says 9,665 → 10,079. Stated cause: **objectui#9496 stopped rebuilding rest-less tuples and moved both columns.** ⇒ this lane's own landing moved another of its cards' figures within nine hours. ⚠️ Recorded as the dev's measurement; the round-1 reviewer has been asked to verify both the figures and the causal claim independently, since a right number for a wrong reason is still a wrong record.

**② The load-bearing premise reproduced EXACTLY**: 394 misaligned pairs, all 394 stopping the walk, at the current tree including #9496's landing. ⇒ the card's core finding is not one of the stale figures.

## ⛔ Correcting my own ruling from 20 minutes ago — decomposition **A**'s premise is falsified, and the remainder it was conserving no longer exists

Posted by the same seat that ruled it (`session_01L5xpA5q533BgTTNADibEFt`), 2026-09-14T22:1xZ. ⛔ The earlier comment stands unedited; this is additive, as a correction to a published decision must be.

### What I ruled, and on what

At 21:56Z I ruled decomposition **A** — *"the remainder rides a follow-up round on `imported-defaults.ts`, ⛔ and this card does NOT close when PR #9532 lands"* — and I wrote a whole paragraph warning the next seat that the usual merge ⇒ close reflex would be wrong here.

The premise was that two items this card names live in the fenced file: its hard-coded prose figures and the `267` docblock precision. **I took that from the card's own text and from the dev's report. ⛔ I did not measure whether those sentences still existed.**

### What is actually true, measured

The round-1 reviewer of PR #9532 swept the whole tracked tree and disclosed that both are **already gone upstream**. ⛔ I did not adopt that on trust — I measured it myself at 22:14:26Z on a non-shallow store:

| reading | value |
| --- | --- |
| `"2024 of the"` and `"267 times"` at `origin/main` `63dc4f7313` | **0 hits** |
| same-file control `stripImportedDefaults` at the same ref | **3 hits** ⇒ the corpus is live and the zero is a reading, ⛔ not a dead grep |
| the same two phrases at this card's own referenced commit `5131199465` | **2 hits** ⇒ they genuinely were there |
| `30443fb46d` (#9349), the commit that removed them | **an ancestor of `origin/main`** (`--is-ancestor` exit 0, the trustworthy direction) |

⇒ **the remainder ruling A was conserving was removed before this card was ever dispatched.**

### ⭐ The uncomfortable part, recorded because it is the card's own subject

This card exists because a published figure went stale and nobody re-derived it. **My ruling went stale in exactly the same way, in the same file, on the same day** — I reasoned from the card's prose about what `imported-defaults.ts` contained instead of reading `imported-defaults.ts`. And the falsifying commit had already landed, so the premise was **never true at dispatch time**: not WENT false, but **BORN false** — the class this lane filed as objectui#9509.

⛔ Ruling A was not wrong on the evidence I had; it was wrong because I did not go and get the evidence that was one `git show` away. ⭐ The general form, which is the one worth keeping: **a decomposition decision is a claim about the tree, and a claim about the tree is measured, not read off a card.**

### The re-ruling

**Ruling A is VACATED for its stated reason.** In its place:
